messages:
mira: Hey team — I'm prepping a docs PR to migrate the legacy burst_policy examples to the new ScalePolicy API for Dedicated. Need a concise migration example (Terraform + SDK) and to clarify SLA/isolation behavior during preemption. Also noticed a broken link in the Reserved Pools section. Anyone can take the Go SDK snippet?
leo: I can do the Go snippet. What's the exact target shape? Is it something like scale_policy { min_replicas = 1, target_utilization = 0.65 } ?
sam: yes that matches what runtime expects; also recommend including a small note about fallback_model semantics when capacity runs out. I'll add a short perf table to the doc about latency delta.
anya: Important: call out that tenant-level label `isolation: tenant` plus reserved_pool assignment prevents eviction during cooldown windows. We should include an explicit tenant YAML snippet showing labels + pool binding.
mira: Draft plan: 1) Terraform migration example converting burst_policy -> scale_policy; 2) Go + Python SDK snippets for create/update; 3) tenant YAML for isolation example; 4) fix reserved pools link; 5) short SLO note about preemption windows and expected tail latency.
leo: here's a quick Go snippet I used earlier (will adapt to docs):
```go
ctx := context.Background()
client := redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
policy := &redwood.ScalePolicy{MinReplicas:1, TargetUtilization:0.65}
req := &redwood.CreateDedicatedPoolReq{
    Name: "tenant-acme",
    ScalePolicy: policy,
}
_, err := client.Dedicated.CreatePool(ctx, req)
if err != nil {
    // handle
}
```
sam: Python snippet would be helpful for a lot of customers; i'll paste one in a sec. Also we should show a minimal Terraform example and a short migration diff.
mira: Also need wording review — avoid inconsistent verbs: we use "preempt" for infra reclaim and "evict" for tenant workload restarts. Can someone proofread the SLO paragraph?
anya: i'll review wording tomorrow morning. ping me when PR is up.
docs-bot: PR opened by @mira: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3482  :eyes:
leo: quick nit — in Terraform we should keep examples to HCL 0.13+ and not show multiple legacy variants. Keep it simple.
mira: ok we'll keep only latest HCL and a one-line diff for people on older versions.
sam: here's the Python SDK snippet for updating a pool (simple PATCH style example):
```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.dedicated.update_pool("tenant-acme", scale_policy={"min_replicas":1, "target_utilization":0.65})
print(resp)
```
mira: thank you. Action items: @leo add Go snippet to PR, @sam add Python + Terraform HCL + migration diff, @anya add YAML isolation example + wording tweaks, @mira will fix reserved pools link and add the SLO blurb. Aim to merge by Fri EOD. :thumbsup:
leo: on it. will push a small changeset tonight.
anya: drafting YAML now, attaching to the PR when ready.
mira: small reminder: include a short "rollback and quality" note about fallback_model — apps should expect quality regression when falling back to a smaller model.
sam: noted, i'll add a 'quality caveats' subsection with an example metric to watch (embed_similarity or perplexity).
mira: perfect. i'll follow up with PR comments and ping reviewers. /cc @platform-oncall
